manifest.budgets: identical training strings/exposures; actual compute costs reported
limitations: one hand-designed rule family and structured fixed-length input
cyclic invariance is supplied by the encoder, not learned
nonempty or stable SDR codes are not semantic labels
numpy payload is a lower bound, not process RAM
development results require new sealed tasks before confirmation
manifest.reproducibility: scores/counts deterministic for matching source and dependencies; hashes identify but do not embed source; wall-clock timings are not deterministic
manifest.scope: within-family combination transfer; NOT unseen-rule learning or AGI
manifest.split_unit: whole five-character string; no overlapping stream windows
manifest.statistics: per-seed paired case bootstrap; no pooling seeds as independent cases
manifest.task: known endpoint associations with held-out whole strings
manifest.threshold_policy: negative dev only; strict score > empirical quantile

noise_control.note: stable partial clusters on noise are not semantic discoveries
